# Uchinchi tomon kutubxonalari

Brauzer tomonida ishlatiladi; CDN ga bog'liq bo'lmaslik uchun shu yerda saqlanadi (npm paketlaridan o'zgarishsiz olingan).

| Fayl | Paket | Litsenziya |
|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) 12.0.2 | MIT — `marked.LICENSE.md` |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) 3.2.6 | Apache-2.0 yoki MPL-2.0 — `purify.LICENSE.txt` |

Yangilash: `npm pack marked dompurify`, arxivdan `marked.min.js` va `dist/purify.min.js` ni shu papkaga ko'chiring.
